caption: A train runs through a tunnel with its headlight on, lighting the walls ahead of it while the walls behind fall back into darkness.

sa.check: A train runs through a tunnel.
It lights the walls ahead of it.
The walls behind fall back into darkness.

pc.expect: The lit stretch stays ahead of the train and moves with it, and the wall darkens once the train has passed.
pc.fail: The walls behind stay lit; or the far end is lit before the beam reaches it; or the lit stretch is behind the train.

pc.expect: The lit stretch moves only as the train moves.
pc.fail: It moves with the train stopped; or jumps; or the beam swings.

pc.expect: The beam is one cone from the headlight.
pc.fail: It bends; or splits; or floods the whole tunnel.

pc.expect: The train travels steadily along the track.
pc.fail: It jumps position; or reverses; or leaves the rails.
A second train appears; or the tunnel vanishes; or the train passes through the wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tunnel walls and the train stay the same.
pc.fail: The walls change; or the train changes colour; or the track changes.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
